uniqueSessions.description: Daily uniques summed across the range.

userId.description: Inverge user id to attach the screening record to

canRequest.description: True when the account may submit a new request. False while pending or approved.

source.description: How the current grant was issued; null before any request.

available.description: False when the operator has disabled analytics reads; entitlement may still be recorded.

canRequest.description: True when the account may request premium access; false while pending or approved.

duplicates.description: Duplicate event keys skipped on an inline write.

persisted.description: Rows written inline; 0 when the batch was queued.

uniqueSessions.description: Daily uniques summed into the bucket.

sharePct.description: Share of views; null for a zero total.

uniqueSessionsExact.description: False when the range predates raw-event retention and the value is the sum of daily uniques.

value.description: number | string | boolean | string[] depending on the question type

alt.description: Alt text. Required: it is what a screen reader reads.

src.description: An https URL or a same-origin asset path.

allocationPercent.description: Share of the amount left after the fixed 20% working-capital tranche, e.g. "30" or "12.5". All milestone weights must total exactly 100% on their own.

expectedAt.description: ISO date for the on-chain milestone deadline.

blockers.description: Human-readable reasons funds-eligibility is not met; empty when eligible.

objectionWindowDays.description: Objection window in days. The programme fixes it at 7.

rewardTiers.description: Reward tiers as authored by the creator. Stored as a JSON projection; fulfilment semantics are validated by the web layer and reviewed before publication.

targetAmount.description: USDC target as an exact decimal string.

workingCapitalPercent.description: The initial working-capital tranche: exactly 20% of the target, released at funding close. Milestone weights divide what remains and total 100% on their own.

parentId.description: Reply to another comment (its id); omit for a top-level comment

askBreakdown.description: Indicative breakdown of what the ask will buy (object or array)

coverImageUrl.description: Cover image URL for image-led cards

creatorPrePledgeTarget.description: Creator-declared expected pre-pledge minimum in USD (FR-204). The gate requires the weighted figure to clear max(platform floor, this).

currentAlternative.description: What the user does today and why it falls short

region.description: Creator-declared region/origin (e.g. "Lagos"). Feeds discovery personalization (region match / diaspora-origin) — never a validation metric.

risks.description: Risks and challenges section (P2 coaching context)

roadmapSteps.description: At least two dated roadmap steps

targetUser.description: Who specifically has this problem (named user type, not "everyone")

taxonomy.description: Discovery taxonomy assignment. Optional: an idea whose honest fit is none stays unassigned. The legacy `category` remains the builder bucket and is not this taxonomy.

accessToken.description: Identity token from the auth/wallet provider (Web3Auth id_token). In stub mode use "stub:<did>[:<email>]".

walletAddress.description: Solana address to link. Verified against the signed identity token; it is never trusted as given. Omit to sign in without linking a wallet.

expiresAt.description: Optional paid-through instant for an approval. Omit for access without expiry.

reason.description: Required (20-2000 characters) for REQUEST_CHANGES and REJECT; optional note for APPROVE.

code.description: Stable `SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE` code a client may branch on.

details.description: Optional validation entries or route-specific context. Shape depends on the failure; clients must narrow before use.

message.description: Human text. May change; do not parse it.

highlighted.description: Feature this comment in the idea comments section

truncated.description: True when the country list was capped.

uniqueSessionsIsSum.description: True because bucket uniques are daily uniques summed, not a distinct range count.

conversion.description: Premium-only; null for a basic entitlement.

subcategory.description: Subcategory slug. Must belong to the selected category; omit it when the parent is the honest level of fit.

estimatedInterestUsd.description: Weighted estimated interest in USD; intent, never received funds.

ownershipSignature.description: Signature proving ownership of the address

updated.description: Rows moved from unread to read.

data.description: Template parameters. Never contains secrets or free text.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null at the end.

total.description: Only present when the route can answer it cheaply.

asOf.description: When the counters were read. The response may be served from a 60 s cache.

publishedIdeas.description: Ideas a visitor can find through GET /ideas: published (VALIDATING or THRESHOLD_MET) and discoverable (DISCOVERABLE or FEATURED).

totalCampaigns.description: Campaigns in any public state (ACTIVE, FUNDED, FAILED, COMPLETED). Drafts, review and rejected rows are excluded.

currency.description: FR-210: USD default; NGN normalized to USD at the current fx rate.

acceptTerms.description: Explicit acceptance of the campaign terms being committed on-chain. Recorded separately from the wallet signature.

reason.description: Reviewer reasoning recorded in the audit trail

reasonCode.description: Stable reason code, never free text

date.description: ISO date (or period label) for this step

sessionToken.description: One-hour HS256 session token. The web BFF stores it in an HttpOnly cookie and never returns it to the browser.

legalName.description: Registered legal name of the business

applicationFeeChargeId.description: SUCCEEDED APPLICATION_FEE charge id (FR-311). Required when the campaign has not already linked one; re-submission after a change request reuses it.

attemptId.description: Deployment attempt the signature belongs to. Supplying a different attempt is rejected rather than applied.

signature.description: Base58 transaction signature returned by the wallet after sending.

publicIdeaCount.description: Public ideas currently assigned to this category, including ideas assigned only at the parent level.
